stage: Round 5, declared before its first life: the teacher. The round 4 arm fields256_p unchanged, its lessons the soft path through its own beliefs (the share of the transcript's paths that say each symbol at each step) in place of the forced path's one symbol, the beliefs read from the brain itself before every batch, the lesson's rates at 0.3 of the composed. Six passes, read after every pass, beside CTC controls at its parameter count, on twelve fresh founders.

data.corpus: LibriSpeech (CC BY 4.0), openslr.elda.org mirror; md5 train-clean-100 2a93770f6d5c6c964bc36631d331a522, train-clean-360 c0e676e450a7ff2f54aeade5171606fa, dev-clean 42e2234ba48799c1f50f24a7926300a1
data.list: words-2000.txt (md5 c3653e7a4315440a0088e2a3d0576081): the 2,000 most frequent words of the train-clean-100 and train-clean-360 transcripts with their counts (speech.py words)
data.train: every utterance of train-clean-100 and train-clean-360 whose every word is on the list, at most 12 seconds, in the corpus's order: 2,100 utterances, 223,960 steps, 8,990.6 seconds (train.npz md5 f0b91a336f9beeeed359967fba454d9b)
data.held: every such utterance of dev-clean that fits (at most 300, seed 0): 274 utterances, 23,378 steps, 939.2 seconds, no speaker on both sides (held.npz md5 ec4c2c1ae7689b3b0d198e27c1f0aa0c)
data.steps: 40 ms; a step hears its 24 latest 10 ms frames of 40 log-mel bands as a 40 by 24 image, less the window's mean, standardized per band on the training windows, clipped at 3 and scaled by 0.3 (speech.py prepare-listed)

brain.note: Brain.compose((40, 24), 29, backend='torch', device='cuda', precision='float32', seed=s, learned_fields=64, modules=(256,), fields_motor=1.0, learning_surprise=False, **actor rates at zero): 1,285,724 parameters, round 4's arm unchanged; its lesson rates (eta and eta_bias as composed) times 0.3 from the first batch (Brain.retune, rate 0.3). 32 utterances heard side by side as streams, each batch from rest; 66 batches a pass, 396 batches a life. A reading after every pass (probe_every 66). The brain is saved at rest every 8 batches and a stopped life continues from the latest save (speech.save_slot).

teacher_note: Before every batch, the first included, the brain itself, at rest with its learned fields held (no parameter moves; cadence.speech.align.log_beliefs(hold=True) as the chamber's batch_beliefs on the brain), answers the batch's utterances greedily, and each utterance's steps take the soft path of its text through those log beliefs (cadence.speech.align.soft_path, sharpness 1: CTC's forward and backward sums over the transcript's paths, blank allowed on any step and required between a letter and the same letter after it). Each step is one soft_step: Brain.lesson(targets=the step's distributions, blank after an utterance's end), then a greedy act; the learned fields take one step a moment, at the act. No backward pass in the brain; the teacher reads the brain's beliefs and the text alone.

controls.device: torch on the box's GPU (controls_device cuda), the first weights drawn on the CPU from the founder; a development check on founder 304500 read the offline transformer at .366, .425, .438 after epochs 1 to 3 against .370, .422, .439 on the CPU in round 4
modes: online: 6 passes in the brain's orders, one Adam step per utterance (rate 0.003), read after every pass
offline: shuffled epochs (rate 0.001), read after every epoch, to the stopping rule (patience 3) or 12 epochs
controls.order: the offline transformers first (the gates' comparator), then the offline LSTMs, the online transformers, the online LSTMs

readings: After every pass, on the 274 held-out utterances by the CTC reading, for every learner: characters; inserted, deleted and substituted characters per character; the letter from the sound, its emission given the letter, the word given its letters (speech.locate); words and exact transcripts against the open lexicon and matched to the list (each said word replaced by the nearest list word: vocabulary.Matcher); every held-out transcript and the 28 by 28 letter confusions (speech.confusions); seconds of training, re-alignment and reading.

gates.G1_characters: For each of the twelve founders, d = the brain's characters after pass 6 minus the offline CTC transformer's characters of the same founder after its epoch 6 (after its last epoch where its stopping rule ended it sooner). G1 holds when the mean of d over the twelve founders is at or above -.03 and d is at or above -.03 on at least 10 of the 12. Round 4's gate, read at its P* = 6.
gates.G2_letter_from_sound: The same pairing on the letter from the sound, with -.05 in both places.
gates.ceiling: Read beside the gates, with the same bars and no gate of its own: each founder's brain after pass 6 against its offline CTC transformer's highest characters (and highest letter from the sound) over all of its epochs.
gates.round_4: Read beside the gates, no gate: the brain's mean at each pass against round 4's twelve fresh founders of the same arm under the forced path (unpaired: other founders).
gates.located_negative: Where a gate fails: for each of the four terms (the letter from the sound, emission given the letter, deleted characters per character, characters) and each learner, the earliest pass whose mean over founders is within .01 of that learner's mean at pass 6, and the brain's gap to the offline transformer at passes 1 to 6.
gates.words: List-matched words are read for every learner at every pass, ungated.

stop: One life per process; every life kept and reported; a life a lost machine stops continues from its last save, a control from its last whole pass. No setting changes after a life is read.
box: one g5.4xlarge (NVIDIA A10G), spot in us-east-1; records to the lane's S3 bucket every minute
